verdict.rationale: Airweave documents a self-hosted deployment via `./start.sh` on macOS/Linux/WSL that spins up a local dashboard (airweave-docs-11, airweave-docs-14, airweave-docs-31), which partially supports local/self-host deployment. However, there is no evidence that the memory/search layer can run fully offline against local embedding/LLM models — search and sync features throughout the docs reference AI agents, tool calling, and cloud-oriented integrations (airweave-docs-4, airweave-docs-19) with no mention of local model support or elimination of cloud API dependencies. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of local/embedded model support for embeddings and search, and evidence of running without any external API calls.
